section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single study. The sample consisted of 228 undergraduate Black female college students (mean age 19.89, mean BMI 24.71) from a large, urban university in the Mid-Atlantic. Participants were recruited from psychology courses and data was collected online via SONA Systems, with BMI calculated from self-reported height and weight.
